substrate: RTT Resonant-Time Triad — T_R = (f_R, τ_R, Q_R)

claim_source.33_day_intellectual: Teltscher (~1920s) — 33-day intellectual cycle, derived from student-performance tallies
claim_source.fused_triple: The combined 23/28/33-day triple is a later composite. It is not a single 1897 claim. The input_claim canonical form reflects the fused system as it is typically presented; the attribution must not.

_meta: Single-pass evaluation. The biorhythm birth-chart claim is dropped onto the existing RTT substrate. No new operators, disposition arms, or module machinery are introduced. The substrate produces the result.

input_claim.label: Biorhythm Birth-Chart Claim
input_claim.canonical_form: Human performance and well-being across physical, emotional, and intellectual dimensions are governed by three sinusoidal cycles of fixed periods — 23 days (physical), 28 days (emotional), 33 days (intellectual) — each phase-locked to the individual's date of birth. Performance at any future date is predictable from these cycles alone.
input_claim.invoked_authority: biological rhythm, cycle science, chronobiology vocabulary

substrate_mapping._meta: Each field of T_R = (f_R, τ_R, Q_R) is tested in turn. No field may erase the others. The result is the relation of the three statuses.

f_R.label: Frequency — what period does the claim declare?
f_R.status_note: Three fixed periods are named with a phase anchor. This is a legal shape for a local clock on the RTT substrate. A declared period occupies the f_R slot. The shape is not a lock — occupying the slot does not validate the carrier.
f_R.rtt_operator: cycle operator ⟳ — period is named; carrier must follow independently
f_R.self_bind: RTT cycle notation is a description grammar. The fact that a period can be written in RTT syntax does not constitute evidence that the carrier exists.

tau_R.label: Memory Time — what carrier maintains the rhythm?
tau_R.required: A real rhythm has a relaxation time (τ_R) tied to a physical or biochemical carrier. Examples: light-dark entrainment for circadian (~24 h); estrogen/progesterone cycling for the menstrual cycle (~28 days); ultradian cortisol pulses (~90 min).
tau_R.claim_offers: Birthdate only. No carrier mechanism is named. No entrainment pathway is specified. No relaxation time is given.
tau_R.status_note: τ_R slot is unfilled. The claim has a period and a phase anchor but no mechanism to sustain the oscillation across a lifetime. Without a carrier, the clock is a label, not a clock.
tau_R.consequence: A cycle without a carrier cannot couple, cannot be disrupted by known perturbants (shift work, illness, trauma), and cannot produce the predictions the claim requires. The empty τ_R slot is the primary structural failure.

Q_R.label: Quality — what does measurement return?
Q_R.empirical_reference: Hines, T. (1998). Comprehensive review of biorhythm theory. Psychological Reports, 83(1), 19–64.
Q_R.finding: Published controlled tests do not beat chance. Positive results fail on method (unblinded, small N, post-hoc period selection). The null result is the best-replicated result.
Q_R.status_note: Q_R is low. The declared periods produced no predictive signal above noise across the reviewed literature. Paradox resilience fires here on the mismatch between declared period and measured period: three periods are declared; zero are confirmed. The Hines review is both: the bulk of studies return null, and the studies that claim positive results do not survive methodological scrutiny. Both halves of that split belong to Q_R directly. No prior track vocabulary applies.
Q_R.rtt_operator: Paradox Resilience — fires on mismatch between a declared period and the measured period. Here: three declared periods, zero confirmed periods. Paradox resilience is not a verdict engine; it marks the gap for examination.
Q_R.paradox_resilience_output: Gap confirmed. Declared f_R is present as a label. Measured f_R is absent. The gap is between a declared period and a measured period — that is what paradox resilience marks. It marks the gap for examination; it does not classify the cause of the gap.

coupling_slot.label: Coupling — do the three cycles produce interference?
coupling_slot.claim: The three cycles (23/28/33 days) interact. Their interference produces performance peaks (all three positive) and critical days (cycle crossings), which are the most predictive events in the system.
coupling_slot.rtt_requirement: Interference is a coupling claim. Coupling on the RTT substrate requires two or more real oscillators with confirmed f_R and τ_R. Coupling is evaluated after the individual oscillators are confirmed.
coupling_slot.status_note: The coupling slot is legitimately used — three-cycle interference is a well-formed coupling claim in RTT structure. But coupling requires the three clocks to be real. τ_R is empty for all three. Q_R is unmatched for all three. The coupling prediction inherits the emptiness of the individual oscillators. An interference pattern between three absent carriers is not an interference pattern.
coupling_slot.consequence: Critical-day predictions are ungrounded. The coupling claim does not rescue the individual cycle claims; it multiplies their structural failure.

adjacent_real_cycles._meta: Cycles that legitimately occupy the RTT substrate in the chronobiology domain. Logged here to make the non-transfer rule explicit.

adjacent.label: Circadian Rhythm
adjacent.tau_R: Light-dark entrainment via suprachiasmatic nucleus; melatonin and cortisol as carriers
adjacent.Q_R: High — disruption measurable, period confirmed across species
adjacent.substrate_status: Confirmed local clock on RTT substrate

adjacent.label: Ultradian Rhythm (basic rest-activity cycle)
adjacent.Q_R: Moderate-to-high — well-documented in sleep architecture and alertness studies
adjacent.substrate_status: Confirmed local clock on RTT substrate

adjacent.label: Menstrual Cycle
adjacent.f_R: ~21–35 days (individual variation is real; 28 days is a mean, not a fixed period)
adjacent.Q_R: High — carrier, period, and phase well-characterized
adjacent.substrate_status: Confirmed local clock on RTT substrate
adjacent.borrowing_note: The menstrual cycle's ~28-day mean does NOT transfer to the biorhythm emotional cycle. The periods share a rough numerical value. They do not share a carrier, an entrainment mechanism, or a measurement history. Shared vocabulary is not entailment.

adjacent_real_cycles.non_transfer_rule: Adjacent cycles occupy their own f_R and τ_R slots on the substrate. Their confirmed status does not migrate to the birth-chart claim. Circadian rhythm is not a parameter range of the 23-day physical cycle. Menstrual rhythm is not a confirmation of the 28-day emotional cycle. These are different claims that share the word cycle and, in one case, a rough period value. The Temporal Substrate Reform pack handles real cycles — including calendar, Metonic, and DST discontinuities — without referencing a birth sinusoid.

four_line_result._meta: The substrate output. Four lines. No new operators. No disposition arms. No pseudoscience module.
four_line_result.line_1: f_R: declared — three periods named, phase-locked to birthdate. Legal slot occupation. Shape is not a lock.
four_line_result.line_2: τ_R: empty — no carrier mechanism named. The clock has a label and no engine.
four_line_result.line_3: Q_R: unmatched — published controlled tests return null. Paradox resilience marks the gap between declared and measured period.
four_line_result.line_4: Coupling: ungrounded — three-cycle interference is a coherent coupling claim, but coupling requires real oscillators. τ_R is empty for all three. The coupling prediction inherits the structural failure of its inputs.

substrate_verdict.relation: The birth-chart claim declares a local clock (f_R occupied), provides no carrier (τ_R empty), produces no predictive signal (Q_R unmatched), and makes a coupling claim whose inputs are unconfirmed.
substrate_verdict.no_new_machinery: The existing RTT substrate — T_R = (f_R, τ_R, Q_R), the cycle operator ⟳, the coupling slot, and the paradox resilience check — produces the full evaluation. No gate-score-disposition stack is needed. No new operators are introduced.
substrate_verdict.what_this_demonstrates: This signal — the birth-chart biorhythm claim — fails to fill τ_R. That is what this pass shows: this claim, on this substrate, at this evaluation. It does not show that every pseudoscience claim produces an empty τ_R. Some claims fill τ_R with a false carrier and retain it after the mechanism is corrected (e.g., charcoal-as-chelator in the bloodstream). The slot result is not a general theory. It is a result for this signal.
substrate_verdict.open_slot: If a future claimant names a carrier mechanism for any of the three periods, that mechanism occupies τ_R and can be evaluated on its own merits. The slot is empty, not sealed. An empty τ_R is an invitation to fill it correctly, not a permanent refusal.

rtt_self_bind.statement: RTT vocabulary is a description grammar. It is never evidence that a claim is true. The fact that the biorhythm claim can be mapped onto T_R does not confirm the claim. The mapping reveals what is present, what is absent, and what is ungrounded. A relabel is not a result.

lineage.architecture_note: The v1.x gate-score-disposition stack and the v2.0 triadic relation table were both intermediate architectures. This document is the resolution: drop the claim onto the existing substrate and read what the substrate returns. The substrate was already there. The module was looking for a door in a building that had none.
